english:
Psalm 131 [132]: "Your priests." Proverbs 8:12: "I, wisdom" to verse 21: "regarded." Prophet Nahum 2:1: "Strengthen with power" to verse 7: "were revealed." Apostle 1 Timothy 5:17: "Let the elders that rule well" to verse 21: "partiality." Alleluia: "Your priests." Gospel Luke 9:23: "And he said to them all" to verse 27: "the kingdom of God."

Wednesday. Hymn of Repentance [Harts]. Midday Psalm 64 [65]: "Save your servants." Apostle Ephesians 1:15: "For this reason" to 2:3: "like the rest." Alleluia: of the Fast, from the Tone. Gospel Luke 8:22: "And it came to pass on one" to verse 25: "obey him."

Thursday. Of the Holy Patriarchs: Metrophanes, Alexander, and Paul the Confessor, and the scribes Marcian and Martyrius. Tone 4 [Dzd]: "Who partook." Magnification [Mankunk] Tone 4 [Dzd]: "Today the heavenly hosts with us." Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [Gy]: "Glorious." Midday Introit: "Of the Patriarchs." Hymn Tone 3 [Gy]: "The leaders." Psalm 131 [132]: "Priests." Proverbs of Wisdom 6:22: "Now if you desire" to verse 26: "of the nations." Prophet Zechariah 12:6: "In that day" to verse 10: "of mercy." Apostle Hebrews 13:7: "Remember your leaders" to verse 9: "have walked." Alleluia: "Your priests." Gospel Matthew 4:23: "And Jesus went about" to verse 25: "he healed them."

Friday. Hymn of Rest [Harts]. Midday Psalm 97 [98]: "All have seen." Apostle Ephesians 2:4: "But God" to verse 22: "of God in the Spirit." Alleluia: from the Tone. Gospel Luke 8:40: "And as he returned" to verse 47: "in peace."

Saturday. Of the Holy Archangels: Gabriel and Michael, and all the Heavenly Hosts. Tone 2 [Bk]: "Who from non-existence created" with its proper canons. Magnification: "Mother and Virgin." Alleluia: "Who makes his angels spirits," Response: "Bless the Lord from the heavens." "Glory and worship." "The ranks of angels." Again: "King forever," "Heaven and earth." Psalm: "Heavens of heavens." Morning Song: "Bless the Lord." Litany: "God great." Magnification [Mankunk] Tone 8 [Dk] (proper): "Heavenly flock chosen." After: "For peace." Prayer: "Holy art thou, Lord." Gradual [Mekhedi]: "I loved." Song: "The Lord after creation." Petition: "Christ our God." Litany: "By the holy ascetics." Prayer: "Crowner of saints."
Midday Introit: "Whom they bless," and "Today the earthly." Hymn Tone 8 [Gk]: "Today rejoicing." Psalm 148: "Praise the Lord." Book of Genesis 18:33: "And the Lord departed" to 19:2: "your way." Book of Job 38:4: "Where were you when I" to verse 7: "my angels praised." Prophet Isaiah 6:1: "And it came to pass in the year" to verse 7: "shall purge from you." Prophet Ezekiel 1:1: "And it came to pass in the thirtieth" to verse 20: "in the wheels." Apostle Hebrews 1:6: "But when again" to verse 14: "salvation." Alleluia: "By the mercy of the Lord." Gospel Matthew 18:10: "Take heed" to verse 14: "of these."
In the Evening: "Joyous Light." Gradual [Mekhedi]: "I loved." Dismissal Hymn [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [Ad]: "Holy art thou, Lord." Litany: "Let us ask," "Save." Prayer: "King of peace."

Ninth Sunday after the Holy Cross.
Tone 8 [Dk]. Hymn [Harts] Tone 8 [Dk]: "Today rejoices." Magnification: "Splendid Mother of God." Midday Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to thee." Prophet Isaiah 24:1: "Behold, the Lord" to verse 13: "shall be in the land." Apostle Ephesians 5:15: "See then that you" to verse 33: "her husband." Alleluia: from the Tone. Gospel Luke 8:49: "While he was speaking" to verse 56: "what had happened."

Monday. Of the Saints: Miletus, Patriarch of Antioch, and Minas the Egyptian, and the other Miletus the bishop, Buras the priest, and Shinu the deacon. Hymn of the Martyrs [Harts]. Midday Hymn Tone 3 [Gy]: "The leaders." Psalm 131 [132]: "Your priests." Proverbs of Wisdom 4:7: "But the righteous" to verse 15: "his chosen." Prophet Isaiah 12:1: "And you shall say on that day" to verse 6: "in the midst of them." Catholic Epistle 1 John 5:1: "Whosoever believes" to verse 6: "Jesus Christ." Alleluia: "Your priests."
